from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAccountsPayable(BaseModel):
    """Accounts payable information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code if mentioned in the report")
    accounts_payable_balance: float | None = Field(description="Accounts payable balance amount in yuan")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial report period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    category: str | None = Field(description="Category based on threshold: 高应付账款, 中应付账款, 低应付账款")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_accounts_payables: list[CompanyAccountsPayable]
